limitations: Only same-session assistant-reviewed annotations. No independent acceptance set.
All capture X are negative; six historical positive-X sources deferred because their HUD geometry differs.
Font-cell boxes are approximate, visually checked rather than pixel-tight.

training.purpose: Expanded own labels, same 200 epoch recipe as pilot. Framework val=train, never heldout. Fixed final checkpoint, no dev selection.

initializer.purpose: Official generic COCO detector initialization, approved by user. Not community game-coordinate weights.

score.scope: 67 training text frames at 42 XYZ. Frozen same-session170 present,141 absent,8 unknown development frames, not independent acceptance.

export.scope: Own expanded checkpoint, offline CPU ONNX proof only. No client integration.

onnxConsistency.scope: ONNX/PyTorch decoded-XYZ consistency, not recognition accuracy or acceptance.

nativePixelDiagnostic.reason: Python cv2 5 and compiled native cubic resize differ in low bits; actual native raw outputs used for training. No truth consumed by native pipeline.

conflictDiagnostic.scope: Spatial attribution of frozen-decoder conflict rejects, not an alternative recognition score. Grouping uses predictions only; no character repair or labels.

limitations: Same-session development set used repeatedly, not independent acceptance.
Assistant-reviewed font-cell annotations, not human gold.
No positive-X training added; historical source geometry needs separate handling.
Same epochs on a larger dataset means more optimizer steps; not a compute-matched causal experiment.

frameworkAttribution.name: Ultralytics YOLO11n
frameworkAttribution.ownContribution: Own captured-frame character labels, specialized checkpoint, own frozen spatial coordinate decoder and offline evaluation.
